title: Kestrel Payments Desk Standard — Funding Sources and Payment Rails on Purchase Orders
content:
**Sources of money.** Money is accepted toward an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements from five sources: the buyer (a down payment), the held reservation deposit, Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds, an outside lender, and trade equity.

**Order status.** A payment is posted only on an order whose status is contracted or cancelled; payments on a cancelled order are limited to applying held deposit money against a retained shipping fee.

**Card money — retired clause.** The clause "Combined debit-card and credit-card money on one order, deposit included, may not exceed the program's card payment cap; card money beyond the cap is refused and must come by ACH, wire or cashier's check." is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current card payment basis.

**ACH.** A single ACH payment may not exceed the program's ACH single payment limit.

**Down payment lead time.** A down payment counts toward handover readiness only when it is received no later than the program's down payment lead business days for its channel before the handover date. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays.

**Outside lenders.** Outside lender proceeds must be received within the program's outside lender funding days after the purchase agreement signing date. When they are not, the order is cancelled under the pre-handover cancellation terms with the closure reason financing not completed.

**Kestrel Auto Finance and trade equity.** Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds post when the finance contract is funded, and the entry carries the finance contract as its linked reference. Trade equity posts when the trade-in agreement applies it, and the entry carries the trade-in agreement as its linked reference.

**Lead-time cases (hypothetical, handover on a Friday, no federal holiday that week).**

| Down payment | Received | Counts toward readiness |
|---|---|---|
| ACH, 3 business days | Tuesday | yes (Tuesday is 3 business days before Friday) |
| ACH, 3 business days | Wednesday | no |
| Wire, 1 business day | Thursday | yes |
| Cashier's check, 2 business days | Thursday | no |
| Debit card, 0 business days | Friday | yes |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A buyer of a Kestrel Inspected vehicle wants to send $31000.00 toward the order in one payment. That amount is above the $25000.00 single ACH payment limit, so it cannot come as one ACH payment.

superseded_clauses: Combined debit-card and credit-card money on one order, deposit included, may not exceed the program's card payment cap; card money beyond the cap is refused and must come by ACH, wire or cashier's check.
